Note that as a [[List of PvE-only skills|PvE-only]] skill, [[Skill Tome]]s cannot be used to learn this skill.

==Notes==
{{anomaly|Although not stated in the skill description, the enchantment automatically ends when the user has no overcast.}}
{{anomaly|Unlike the PvE-only elite skills, the descriptions fail to mention that this is a PvE skill.}}
* The Burning duration is applied every second and matches the amount of Overcast removed.
** Under all attribute ranks, Burning is continuous for the purpose of skills like [[Fragility]] and [[Contagion]] (unless the condition is [[List of condition removal skills|removed]], in which case it will be reapplied the next second).
{{anomaly|At low Energy Storage ranks, [[Purifying Veil]] prevents burning on the user entirely. [[Recovery]] is, as noted on the skill's own page, a reduction in duration and requires more than 50% reduction to reduce a 1 second duration burn to a value that is rounded to 0.}}
{{bug|the animation of the Burning condition does not occur the first time the skill is used in an explorable area}}
* Consider using [[Frigid Armor]] to prevent the burning on the user.
* Can be used to counteract the overcast building effects of [[Over the Limit]] or [[Iron Mist]].

==Trivia==
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260826|26th August 2026 update]].
*This and [[Signet of Capture]] are the only [[PvE-only|PvE-only skills]] that can be purchased from regular [[skill trainers]].
*The icon for this skill is a silhouette of [[Cynn]] in a [[:File:Elementalist_render.jpg|concept art]].
